xmldoc.short_description: Return the handle of a block by path, or -1 if not found.

param_input_item.param_description: a block path ('model/BlockName'), or a cell array of block paths.
optional logical; when true, an unloaded model is loaded first if it can be found.

param_output_item.param_description: the numeric handle of the block, or -1 when it is not found. For a cell array of paths, a numeric array of the same shape.

description.p: getNFlowBlockHandle returns the numeric handle of a block given its path, or -1 when the block does not exist (no error is raised).
The handle equals get_param(path, 'Handle') and can be passed to get_param and set_param in place of the path. A path that names only a model (with no block) resolves to -1.
With a cell array of paths, the result is a numeric array of handles of the same shape, each element being the handle or -1.
When load is true and the model is not loaded, it is loaded first if it can be found; otherwise the result is still -1.
